hi.explanation: 'Fe' लैटिन शब्द 'फेरम' (Ferrum) से आया है, जिसका अर्थ लोहा है।

questions.explanation: One-third of the members retire every two years, but each serves a 6-year term.

questions.question: Which fundamental right was described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution?

questions.question: The sum of the ages of A and B is 40 years. 5 years ago, the ratio of their ages was 2:1. Find the current age of A.
questions.explanation: Sum 5 years ago = 40 - 10 = 30. Ratio 2:1 means A was 20 and B was 10. Current A = 20 + 5 = 25.

hi.question: A और B की आयु का योग 40 वर्ष है। 5 वर्ष पहले, उनकी आयु का अनुपात 2:1 था। A की वर्तमान आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
hi.explanation: 5 वर्ष पहले योग = 40 - 10 = 30। अनुपात 2:1 का अर्थ है A 20 वर्ष का था और B 10 वर्ष का। वर्तमान A = 20 + 5 = 25।

questions.question: A train running at 72 km/hr crosses a bridge in 30 seconds. If the train is 200 m long, find the length of the bridge.

questions.question: The ratio of the volumes of two spheres is 8:27. Find the ratio of their radii.

hi.question: दो गोलों के आयतनों का अनुपात 8:27 है। उनकी त्रिज्याओं का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: Find the HCF of 0.6, 1.8 and 0.36.
questions.explanation: Convert to same decimals: 0.60, 1.80, 0.36. HCF of 60, 180, 36 is 12. So, HCF = 0.12.

hi.question: 0.6, 1.8 और 0.36 का HCF ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: A certain sum of money triple itself in 10 years at simple interest. Find the rate of interest.

hi.question: कोई निश्चित राशि साधारण ब्याज पर 10 वर्षों में तिगुनी हो जाती है। ब्याज की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: If the area of an equilateral triangle is 16*sqrt(3) sq.cm, find its perimeter.

hi.question: यदि एक समबाहु त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल 16*sqrt(3) वर्ग सेमी है, तो उसका परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: Find the value of x: (2/3)x + 4 = (1/2)x + 6.
The mean of 5 numbers is 20. If each number is increased by 2, what will be the new mean?

questions.question: If 3x = 5y and 4y = 7z, then x:z is?

hi.question: यदि 3x = 5y और 4y = 7z है, तो x:z क्या है?

questions.question: A cylinder has a radius of 14 cm and its curved surface area is 880 sq.cm. Find its height.

hi.question: एक बेलन की त्रिज्या 14 सेमी है और इसका वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 880 वर्ग सेमी है। इसकी ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: Find the probability of getting a prime number when a die is thrown.
questions.explanation: Prime numbers on a die: 2, 3, 5. Total = 3. Probability = 3/6 = 1/2.

hi.question: एक पासा फेंकने पर अभाज्य संख्या आने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: If 25% of a number is added to the number itself, the result is 750. Find the number.

hi.question: यदि किसी संख्या का 25% उसी संख्या में जोड़ा जाता है, तो परिणाम 750 होता है। संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: The ratio of cost price and selling price is 4:5. Find the gain percent.

questions.question: The perimeter of a rectangle is 48 cm and the ratio of its length and breadth is 5:3. Find the area.

questions.question: A certain amount was split among A, B, C in the ratio 2:3:5. If C received Rs. 2000 more than A, find the share of B.
questions.explanation: Difference (5x - 2x) = 3x = 2000. Actually, if 3x=2000, x isn't integer. Let's recheck. B's share is 3x, which is 2000.

questions.question: If the diagonal of a square is increased by 10%, find the percentage increase in its area.

hi.question: यदि एक वर्ग के विकर्ण में 10% की वृद्धि की जाती है, तो उसके क्षेत्रफल में प्रतिशत वृद्धि ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: A boat travels 24 km downstream in 2 hours and 24 km upstream in 4 hours. Find the speed of the boat in still water.

hi.explanation: अनुकूल गति = 12, प्रतिकूल गति = 6। शांत जल में गति = (12 + 6) / 2 = 9 किमी/घंटा।

questions.question: If a circle's radius is doubled, by how many times does its area increase?
questions.explanation: Area = pi * r^2. If r becomes 2r, Area = pi * (2r)^2 = 4 * pi * r^2.

hi.question: यदि एक वृत्त की त्रिज्या दोगुनी कर दी जाए, तो उसका क्षेत्रफल कितने गुना बढ़ जाएगा?
